quality.selection: original valid result first; first eligible diagnostic retry only when original invalid

interpretation: single short measurements; acquisition bounds are not statistical confidence intervals; common visibility is not irreversible finality

excluded_initial_batch.reason: legacy 16KiB stats response limit rejects >100 ancestor snapshots; no TPS from this batch

protocol.model: frozen preparation-v2; B2 bounded online heads reset per process
protocol.measurement: intersection of ten locally atomic published canonical tails; RPC intervals <=0.5s; persisted anchors rechecked after stopping
protocol.latency: 20Hz planned sampling; first all-node identical transaction position; no irreversible finality claim
protocol.one_retry_cell: A2/40000: original 12s endpoint interval 0.67549s exceeds 0.5s bound
